literal: Wealth having destroyed, falsehood having made to undertake, compassion having destroyed, misery will cause to suffer, gambling.
translation: Gambling destroys one's wealth, forces one to embrace falsehood, ruins one's compassion, and inflicts misery.
modern: சூதாட்டம் ஒருவனின் செல்வத்தை அழித்து, அவனைப் பொய் பேசும்படி செய்து, அவனது இரக்க குணத்தையும் கெடுத்து, அவனுக்குத் துன்பத்தை உண்டாக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the sequential ruin caused by gambling. It begins by destroying a person's wealth, which in turn forces them to embrace falsehood to survive or to keep playing. This deceitful life then destroys their natural compassion for others. The causative verbs emphasize that gambling is an active force that ultimately plunges the gambler into inescapable misery.
